newsitem.title: USA: American HomePatient says to buy Nevada DME.
newsitem.headline: American HomePatient says to buy Nevada DME.

text.p: BRENTWOOD, Tenn. June 2 (Rueter) - American HomePatient Inc said on Monday that it acquired Nevada DME Inc of Boulder City, Nevada.
American HomePatient chief executive Edward Wissing said this was the first acquisition under its previously announced 1997 westward expansion strategy.
Wissing continued that the company sees further opportunities in the markets that border Arizona and Nevada, excluding California.
Nevada Medical Supply has seven home health care locations in the western U.S. and annualized revenues of about $3.4 million.
